title: DATE ( 1850, 1, 2 ) returns January 2, 1850

source.quote: If year is between 100 and 9999 (inclusive), that value is used as the year.
source.supports: years from 100 are used as they are

source.quote: Dates beginning with March 1, 1900 are supported.
source.supports: earlier dates are outside the supported range

source.quote: If Year is between 100 and 9999 (inclusive), DATE uses the value as the year.

derivation: 1850 is between 100 and 9999, so it is used as the year: January 2, 1850. The pages say dates before March 1, 1900 are not officially supported but do not say DATE fails for them; DAX Guide gives DATE ( -50, 1, 2 ) returning January 2, 1850.
alternative: If the engine refuses dates before March 1, 1900, the query fails.
